scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @djdesk/domain && npm run build --workspace @djdesk/server && npm run build --workspace @djdesk/client
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run fmt:check && npm run test
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @djdesk/domain && concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @djdesk/server" "npm run dev --workspace @djdesk/client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @djdesk/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace @djdesk/server && npm run typecheck --workspace @djdesk/client
